title: Lois becomes your friend

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Well in a lot of RPG games there is a system for making friends, or forming relationships. Once you have enough positive interactions with a companion character, they become your friend. Officially.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well in a lot of RPG games there is a system for making friends, or forming relationships. Once you have enough positive interactions with a companion character, they become your friend. Officially.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: For me, you definitely reached the right affinity level. I think of you as a friend. I just wanted you to know that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For me, you definitely reached the right affinity level. I think of you as a friend. I just wanted you to know that.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Well, I'll settle for that. Appreciate it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I'll settle for that. Appreciate it.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Roger. Got ya. Fantastic. Good to know. See ya around bud. Or not... cos we're not buds. But I guess I'll still see ya... so I'll just kinda nod, or walk around like I don't notice you. Kinda like an NPC in a game.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Roger. Got ya. Fantastic. Good to know. See ya around bud. Or not... cos we're not buds. But I guess I'll still see ya... so I'll just kinda nod, or walk around like I don't notice you. Kinda like an NPC in a game.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Whoa, for real? Alright then, I'll get planning. Hey... thanks. Thanks for putting up with me. I mean it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whoa, for real? Alright then, I'll get planning. Hey... thanks. Thanks for putting up with me. I mean it.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Heya bud. Good to see you again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Heya bud. Good to see you again.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You too Lois.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You too Lois.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Hey, so you know we are kinda buds now. I mean... I should use a better word. "Friends." We are friends.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, so you know we are kinda buds now. I mean... I should use a better word. "Friends." We are friends.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure, we're friends.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure, we're friends.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Kinda, yeah.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Kinda, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Right. So you know I make games?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. So you know I make games?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, you tell me every single time we talk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, you tell me every single time we talk.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes, you tell me every single time we talk.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes, you tell me every single time we talk.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you trying to say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you trying to say?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What are you trying to say?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What are you trying to say?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: I guess I am just wondering if... we're at that stage? Me and you? Are we companions now? Have you incremented a friendship variable enough to become my friend? And have I done the same for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess I am just wondering if... we're at that stage? Me and you? Are we companions now? Have you incremented a friendship variable enough to become my friend? And have I done the same for you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I feel the same.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I feel the same.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We're not really friends Lois.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're not really friends Lois.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Nice. I mean, great. Hey, remember before I talked about running away when this whole lockdown was over? You still up for that? I mean, am I the one you want to run away with?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nice. I mean, great. Hey, remember before I talked about running away when this whole lockdown was over? You still up for that? I mean, am I the one you want to run away with?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'd love to escape the city with you bud.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd love to escape the city with you bud.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'd love to escape the city with you bud.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'd love to escape the city with you bud.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe, but just for a holiday. Nivalis is my home.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe, but just for a holiday. Nivalis is my home.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe, but just for a holiday. Nivalis is my home.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe, but just for a holiday. Nivalis is my home.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I like it here in the city, but I'm still your bud.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like it here in the city, but I'm still your bud.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I like it here in the city, but I'm still your bud.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I like it here in the city, but I'm still your bud.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Any time bud.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Any time bud.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We're not really friends.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're not really friends.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's how games work, not real life Lois.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's how games work, not real life Lois.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's how games work, not real life Lois.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's how games work, not real life Lois.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure.
